definition: Human-AI Team Protocols: protocols for effective human-AI teams.

title: Human-AI Team Protocols Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Human-AI Team Protocols: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Human-AI Team Protocols — protocols for effective human-AI teams.

Phase 1 — Prove (team charters): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (protocol logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (role design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (handoff rules): protocol hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and teams-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
